selection: All Pirate T8/T9 states with health >=15 from the 128 sealed assessment-only games; one earliest eligible state per game, no modulo train split and no outcome selection
budget: Two future RNG replicas per eligible source; fixed endpoints, no training or checkpoint selection
comparison: Fresh-source parent and both frozen residual arms; source-paired rank, growth, win/top4. Not natural formation or promotion.
limitations: Fresh sources collected by the same parent policy and snapshot field
